title: Event, Thailand, 5 July 2021 (AC20210705THA)
description:
UNOSAT geodata for Event, Thailand, 5 July 2021 (AC20210705THA), from 2 datasets on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. HDX describes the event:

**UNOSAT code: AC20210705THA**  This map illustrates the damage assessment after the blast of the 5th July 2021 in Bang Phli Yai sub-district, Bang Phli district, Samut Prakan province, Thailand. UNITAR - UNOSAT identified 328 potentially damaged structures of which 13 are destroyed and 315 are severely or moderately damaged. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).

HDX datasets:

- [Damage assessment around the chemical factory, Samut Prakan Province, Thailand](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-around-the-chemical-factory-samut-prakan-province-thailand)
- [Preliminary satellite-derived damage assessment, Bang Phli District, Samut Prakan Province, Thailand](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/preliminary-satellite-derived-damage-assessment-bang-phli-district-samut-prakan-province-t)
